name: Gesaral Beta
description: Gesaral Beta was a planet in the Gesaral Beta system in the Gordian Reach, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square P-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. According to Leo Leonis, it had rain so dangerous that it was capable of killing a human.
lead_paragraphs: Gesaral Beta was a planet in the Gesaral Beta system in the Gordian Reach, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square P-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. According to Leo Leonis, it had rain so dangerous that it was capable of killing a human.
